prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Curium (Cm) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a mine gallery of rough rock walls, timber props, an ore cart on its track and a line of hanging lamps
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a game-show booth model outfit — a sleek bodycon mini dress with glowing trim and a fitted cropped jacket, thigh-high boots — in a clear pattern such as a floral print, bold stripes, gingham or plaid, in two or three cheerful colours; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: kneeling on the ground.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body facing the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — curium: a hard, dense silvery synthetic metal first made in 1944 by striking plutonium with alpha particles, and named, as gadolinium above it honours a chemist, for the husband-and-wife pioneers of radioactivity; its existence slipped out on a children's radio quiz show before the official announcement; today its alpha rays, fired from small spectrometers on the arms of Mars rovers and a comet lander, read what distant rocks are made of — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
